title: Corrective fix for B-fdcf9a45: REVIEW: Spec 0005 review
description:
Blocked reason: recipeFixtureSpotChecks (CooklangParserTests.swift:195-208) asserts only metadata["title"] != nil, metadata["servings"] != nil, and metadata["tags"] != nil. The spec requires exact-value assertions: == "Pasta Bolognese", == "4", and == "italian, pasta, classic" respectively. Weak nil-checks allow a parser regression that returns wrong values to pass undetected.

Remaining work: Developer must strengthen recipeFixtureSpotChecks to assert exact metadata values: metadata["title"] == "Pasta Bolognese", metadata["servings"] == "4", metadata["tags"] == "italian, pasta, classic". Optionally: add RecipesListView collapse-state test or document its deliberate exclusion.
